title: Join Indian Army 10+2 TES-56 January 2027 Online Form
intro: Join Indian Army (Permanent Commission)  has Released Official Notification For Online Application Form for the Post of 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme Course TES-56 (January 2027) Recruitment 2026 for 90 Post. . Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to Army TES 10+2 Jobs. Online Application Start on May 13, 2026 & Last Date is June 12, 2026. All Eligible  & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below..
importantDates: Payment Mode: No Application Fee For any Category Candidates. Only Fill TES-54 Online Application Form.
The candidate  should  not  be born before 02 July 2007 and not after 01 July 2010
Age Relaxation Extra as Per Rules.
Candidates Passed 10+2 (Intermediate) Exam with 60% Marks with PCM Stream.
Candidate must have appeared in JEE (Mains) 2025.
Only Male Unmarried Candidates Are Eligible.
Mode of Selection:  Selection on the Basis of SSB Interview & Merit List
To Be Notified: SSB Interview Dates
Maximum Age: 19 Years 06 Months (Born between 02 July 2007 and 01 July 2010)
10+2 / Intermediate with Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics with minimum 60% marks
Pay Scale: As per Defence Pay Matrix (Level-10) during training + allowances
Selection Process: Shortlisting on Merit + SSB Interview + Medical Examination
Permanent Commission Officer in Indian Army (Technical)
